review_scope: Read-only protocol review before execution; no NPU run and no benchmark source change by reviewer.
question: Does changing resident graph-catalog construction/context alter the upstream-to-whole policy gap while measuring the identical two original records?
critical_implementation_checks: Do not edit or monkey-patch the frozen consumer or Stage7 probe source; use a separate bridge probe with explicit new source hashes.
Use sixteen private resident occurrences, seed1703, original exact lengths, owner page order, mask and the current qualified common consumer/policy binaries.
Each captured bucket owns an independent graph pool and exact cloned length/table/query extents. Retain every selected catalog frame, graph, pool, output and workspace until measurement ends.
Preserve original first-use capture order rather than sorted capacities. The different allocation layout and capture history belong to the catalog-context treatment.
Use an identical explicit measurement-record order in all four cells; do not let trial or cell index rotate the two-record schedule differently.

Qualification and premeasurement replay history must match for the measured records across cells. Additional unused catalog graphs may undergo capture-time safety gates but must not introduce an extra full-trace replay or full-catalog qualification between the common two-record prequalification and warmup.
Five warmups and ten repeats per measured record, the same order and synchronization boundaries, and no active profiling during formal timings.

The complete wall endpoint includes persistent pinned preparation, true necessary H2D, native producer, attention replay and final completion. Readback, hashing, oracle and evidence persistence remain outside timing.
Hash all private base QKV and actual measured frame queries before and after; compare exact policy-plan words/hash for the same measured record across two- and seventeen-catalog cells.
Report measured-record preparation counts separately from setup or unused-catalog construction counts; a catalog must not appear equivalent solely because memory summary values match.
Limit execution to device0 with TASK_QUEUE_ENABLE=0 and preserve every sample and failure without merging prior interrupted or bounded trials.

process_order_comment.linear_drift_note: With equally spaced run positions this interaction has coefficients +,-,-,+ and cancels a common additive linear position trend. Actual runtime spacing differs, so this is only an ordering aid, not proof that drift is removed.
process_order_comment.limitation: One fresh process per cell cannot estimate process-to-process uncertainty. If the concurrent two-catalog reference changes strongly or interaction is near noise, preserve an inconclusive result and run a reverse block only then.

interpretation_gates.both_catalogs_retain_large_policy_gap: Catalog count/construction/residency alone is insufficient to explain Stage7 attenuation; chronological descriptor and execution history becomes the next small control.
interpretation_gates.seventeen_catalog_gap_shrinks: Catalog construction/context affects the policy gap. This does not isolate memory byte count from addresses, graph capture history, allocator placement, device state or any cache mechanism.
interpretation_gates.two_catalog_reference_does_not_reproduce: The historical bounded effect was not concurrently reproduced. Do not attribute a difference to catalog size; retain process/time context as unresolved.
interpretation_gates.scope: A two-record synthetic attention diagnostic, without full-trace, full-model, serving, split-versus-padding or academic-novelty claim.
